feature1.title: ACTS AS A VIRTUAL GENERAL PRACTITIONER:
feature1.content: It reviews your lab results and identifies risk zones, saving you both time and money.

feature2.title: EXPLAINS POTENTIAL CAUSES:
feature2.content: Unlike standard lab reports that only show deviations from the norm, our AI points out potential underlying causes.

feature3.title: STORES EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE:
feature3.content: You will always have access to all your interpreted results, and we are implementing a feature to track your data trends over time.

feature4.title: HIGHLIGHTS RISKS AND CONSEQUENCES:
feature4.content: We explain what might happen if certain indicators continue to decline.

items.question: How does the lab results interpretation work?
items.answer: We extract numerical data from your PDF file, anonymize it, and pass it to a medical AI that compares the findings with reference values and your history of past results.

items.question: Is it safe? Do you store my data?
items.answer: Absolutely. Before analysis, we remove your name and contact information. You have full control over your profile and can delete all uploaded files at any time.

items.question: Does this replace a doctor's visit?
items.answer: No. Our service provides informational guidance and helps you understand complex medical terminology. Always consult a specialist for diagnosis and treatment plans.
